subject: googleVis vs rCharts vs Highcharts, polycharts, etc

messages.author: 6f9739ea511c7a89
messages.subject: googleVis vs rCharts vs Highcharts, polycharts, etc
parts:
Hi all,

Once I discovered googleVis, I never looked back because simple syntax creates great charts.  But now on this forum I'm seeing more and more references to rCharts, High charts, Polycharts, etc.  All the output I've seen is mindblowingly stunning.

In the context of Shiny, what are the pros and cons of using one of those latter packages over googleVis?  

I've found googleVis slightly clunky when lots of reactivity is happening at once (e.g., graphs disappear and never come back when I uncheck boxes too quickly.  I haven't figured out how to use invalidatelater).  Does this not happen with the other charting tools?  

Thanks,
John

messages.author: 129e07bdb789652f
messages.subject: Re: googleVis vs rCharts vs Highcharts, polycharts, etc
parts:
GoogleVis charts are very specific. If you are happy with googleVis, then this is nice, but you can make customized charts with the Javascript libraries.

NB : the rCharts package is an R interface to Javascript libraries (such as Highcharts, Polycharts,...)
